name: com.siftwright/web-data
title: Siftwright web data
description: Web data for agents: YouTube transcripts, screenshots, news, WHOIS, jobs. Try 2 tools free, no key.

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Get transcripts (captions) for YouTube videos, Shorts, playlists or channels as plain text and timed segments, with video metadata. Uses the captions YouTube already has; videos without captions return a failed item. Each video whose transcript comes back counts as one result on your Siftwright plan; failures are free.

urls.description: 1 to 10 YouTube video, Shorts, playlist or channel URLs (or 11-character video IDs).

language.description: Preferred caption language code(s), comma-separated in order of preference. Default en.

translateTo.description: Optional language code to machine-translate the captions into.

tools.name: website_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a PNG or JPEG screenshot, or render a PDF, of public web pages in a real browser. Returns a signed fileUrl per page that can be downloaded without a key for 7 days. Each page captured counts as one result.

fullPage.description: Capture the whole page height. Default true.

waitForSelector.description: CSS selector to wait for before capturing.

tools.name: google_news
tools.description: Search Google News for a keyword, company or topic and get articles as structured data (title, link, source, published time). Each article returned counts as one result.

query.description: What to search for, up to 300 characters.

tools.name: pqc_scan
tools.description: Check whether domains use post-quantum TLS key exchange (X25519MLKEM768 / ML-KEM), which groups they prefer, TLS 1.2/1.3 support, certificate algorithms and expiry, and HSTS, with a letter grade. Each host that answers counts as one result. Works without an API key for one host per call (free daily limit per network); a key unlocks lists.

hosts.description: 1 to 20 public domain names (a URL is fine; the hostname is used).

tools.name: contact_details
tools.description: Find public emails, phone numbers and social profiles (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube) on company websites by crawling up to a few pages of each site. Each website with a successful crawl counts as one result.

maxPagesPerDomain.description: Pages to crawl per site. Default 6.

tools.name: tech_stack
tools.description: Detect what a website is built with: CMS, ecommerce platform, frameworks, analytics, ad pixels, hosting, CDN, email and DNS provider, with the evidence for each detection. Each website that loads counts as one result.

includeDns.description: Add DNS-based detections (email and DNS provider). Default true.

tools.name: app_store_reviews
tools.description: Get Apple App Store reviews for apps (by name, numeric ID or URL) in one or more countries, filtered by rating, keywords and date. Every 25 reviews returned count as one result (rounded up per request).

apps.description: 1 to 5 app names, App Store IDs or URLs.

keywords.description: Keep only reviews mentioning any of these words.

since.description: ISO date; keep only reviews on or after it.

tools.name: ats_jobs
tools.description: List open jobs from company careers pages on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters and Recruitee in one schema (title, team, location, remote, salary when published, apply URL), with title, location, department and recency filters. Every 3 jobs returned count as one result (rounded up per request).

companies.description: 1 to 10 careers-page URLs, company domains, or ats:slug values like greenhouse:airbnb.

includeDescription.description: Include full job description text. Default false.

tools.name: domain_whois
tools.description: Look up who a domain is registered with, when it was created, when it expires, its status, nameservers and DNSSEC (from RDAP/WHOIS registries), plus A, MX, SPF and DMARC records, and whether it looks available. Every 3 domains with a registry answer count as one result (rounded up per request). Works without an API key for one host per call (free daily limit per network); a key unlocks lists.

includeDns.description: Add A, MX, SPF and DMARC records. Default true.
